question: Who has taken on the role of Defence Secretary in the South Block, New Delhi, in November 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajesh Kumar Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Rajesh Kumar Singh was appointed as the **Defence Secretary** in the South Block, New Delhi, in November 2024.
 
• The Defence Secretary is the **administrative head of the Ministry of Defence** and acts as a key advisor to the Government of India on defence-related matters.
 
• Rajesh Kumar Singh has a proven track record of administrative excellence and has previously held **prominent positions within the Indian administrative framework**.
 
• His appointment aligns with the Government of India's focus on enhancing national security and modernizing the defence infrastructure.
 
• The Defence Secretary plays a pivotal role in coordinating between the armed forces, defence production, and policy-making bodies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Defence:**

 
 
• The Ministry of Defence (MoD) is responsible for managing India's national defence, including the armed forces and defence production units.
 
• The MoD oversees key organizations like the Indian Army, Navy, Air Force, and the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO).
 
• It plays a crucial role in formulating defence policies and ensuring the country's security against external threats.
 
 
 
• **Defence Secretary:**
 
 
• The Defence Secretary is a senior civil servant heading the Ministry of Defence, tasked with administrative and financial oversight.
 
• The role includes coordination between the defence forces and policy-making bodies to ensure operational efficiency.
 
• The Defence Secretary is instrumental in implementing reforms and modernization within the armed forces and defence sector.
 
 
 
• **South Block:**
 
 
• South Block is a prominent building in New Delhi that houses key ministries, including the Ministry of Defence, Ministry of External Affairs, and the Prime Minister's Office.
 
• It is strategically located on Raisina Hill and serves as the administrative hub for India's central government.
 
 
 
• **India's Defence Modernization Efforts:**
 
 
• India is focusing on enhancing its defence capabilities through initiatives like Make in India and Atmanirbhar Bharat in the defence sector.
 
• Key priorities include the acquisition of advanced weapon systems, indigenous production, and strengthening cybersecurity measures.
